name: onbudget
description: Run a task under a usage budget: /onbudget $3 <task>, /onbudget 10% 5h <task>, /onbudget 5% week <task>. Meters the task's own spend, shows it to Claude, and refuses requests the budget cannot cover.

effort.title: Effort cap while a budget is set
effort.description: Requests sent under a budget have their reasoning effort lowered to this level (never raised). keep leaves your effort setting alone.

usdPerPoint5h.title: Dollars per point, 5-hour window
usdPerPoint5h.description: Optional. List-price dollars of usage that move your 5-hour usage window by one percentage point. 0 means learn it from this account's own readings.

usdPerPointWeek.title: Dollars per point, weekly window
usdPerPointWeek.description: Optional. List-price dollars of usage that move your weekly usage window by one percentage point. 0 means learn it from this account's own readings.
